hits.text_preview: For asymmetric DL single-TRP and UL multi-TRP operation, the UL TRP may reduce or even disable DL transmission. Pathloss offsets between two TRPs can be configured by RRC and dynamically updated by Pathloss Offset Update MAC CE, which defined in TS 38.321[6]. Each pathloss offset is explicitly indicated for the corresponding UL/Joint TCI state for PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS transmission toward the UL TRP.
